up: List all approved drugs whose mechanism of action is an inhibitor, including compound details (name, ChEMBL ID) and target details (target name, target ChEMBL ID). Filter for molecules where max_phase is 4 (approved) and action_type is 'INHIBITOR'. Return distinct combinations of drug and target.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    md.pref_name,
    md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
    td.pref_name AS target_name,
    td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id
FROM drug_mechanism dm
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON dm.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN target_dictionary td ON dm.tid = td.tid
WHERE dm.action_type = 'INHIBITOR'
    AND md.max_phase = 4
